pages.title: Taurus: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Apr 20 - May 20. Earth element, fixed quality, ruled by Venus.

pages.title: Steadiness
pages.text: Taurus builds slowly and firmly. What they promise, they usually deliver.

pages.title: Stubbornness
pages.text: Once decided, it is hard to change their mind. Hearing another view avoids fights over pride.

pages.title: Loyal and sensual
pages.text: Values affection, presence and real gestures. Trust comes with time.

pages.title: The one who sustains
pages.text: Patient and reliable, good with money, details and long-term goals.
